title: Ginsenoside Rb1 Interfered with Macrophage Activation by Activating PPARgamma to Inhibit Insulin Resistance in Obesity.
authors: Ding, Hongyue; Dong, Jinxiang; Wang, Yuqi; Huang, Qiang; Xu, Jie; Qiu, Zhidong; Yao, Fan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷Rb1通过PPARγ抑制巨噬细胞活化改善肥胖胰岛素抵抗，仅用分子对接预测蛋白-小分子结合，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) is characterized by insulin resistance (IR), often accompanied by inflammation. Macrophage activation acts as an inflammatory response, which is characterized by macrophage recruitment in the initial stage. Ginsenoside Rb1 (Rb1) is a main active ingredient, which is known for its fat-reducing, anti-inflammatory effects. To clarify that Rb1 regulates macrophage activation in adipose tissue and improves tissue inflammation, network pharmacology and molecular docking were used for target prediction and preliminary validation. By constructing the co-culture model of adipose-derived stem cells (ADSC) and primary macrophage (PM), the body adipose tissue microenvironment was simulated to observe the adipogenesis degree of adipocytes under the effect of Rb1. The levels of cytokines, macrophage polarization, and protein or RNA expression in the inflammatory signaling pathway were finally detected. The results showed that 89 common targets of T2D-Rb1 were obtained after their intersection. Furthermore, according to the results of the KEGG pathway and PPI analysis, PTGS2 (COX-2) is the downstream protein of PPARgamma-NF-kappaB. The molecular binding energy of PPARgamma-Rb1 is -6.8 kcal/mol. Rb1 significantly inhibited the increase in MCP-1, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta induced by hypertrophic adipocytes supernatant and promoted the expression of IL-10. Rb1 inhibited the activation of inflammatory macrophages and PM migration and upregulated PPARgamma expression with the blocking of NF-kappaB activation. Additionally, Rb1 promoted the expression of IRS1 and PI3K in the insulin signal pathway, which had a similar effect with ROS. Therefore, Rb1 might affect macrophage activation through PPARgamma, which might alleviate obese insulin resistance in T2D early stage.
abstract_zh: 2型糖尿病（T2D）以胰岛素抵抗（IR）为特征，常伴随炎症。巨噬细胞活化作为一种炎症反应，其初始阶段以巨噬细胞募集为特征。人参皂苷Rb1（Rb1）是一种主要活性成分，以其降脂、抗炎作用而闻名。为阐明Rb1调节脂肪组织中巨噬细胞活化并改善组织炎症，采用网络药理学和分子对接进行靶点预测和初步验证。通过构建脂肪来源干细胞（ADSC）与原发性巨噬细胞（PM）的共培养模型，模拟体内脂肪组织微环境，观察Rb1作用下脂肪细胞成脂程度。最终检测炎症信号通路中细胞因子水平、巨噬细胞极化以及蛋白或RNA表达。结果显示，T2D-Rb1交集后获得89个共同靶点。此外，根据KEGG通路和PPI分析结果，PTGS2（COX-2）是PPARgamma-NF-kappaB的下游蛋白。PPARgamma-Rb1的分子结合能为-6.8 kcal/mol。Rb1显著抑制肥大脂肪细胞上清液诱导的MCP-1、TNF-alpha和IL-1beta升高，并促进IL-10表达。Rb1抑制炎症巨噬细胞活化和PM迁移，上调PPARgamma表达并阻断NF-kappaB活化。此外，Rb1促进胰岛素信号通路中IRS1和PI3K的表达，其作用与ROS相似。因此，Rb1可能通过PPARgamma影响巨噬细胞活化，从而可能缓解T2D早期的肥胖性胰岛素抵抗。
